title: Drama Education as a Medium for Learning II
description: The integration of drama as a learning medium across the curriculum with a focus on language arts. An examination and progression of instructional strategies, broadening understanding of educational drama and its role in the development of multiple literacies.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 305B, EDCI 305, DE 204, DE 304, EDUC 305.
May be offered in English or French.

prerequisites.text: Admission to a program in Teacher Education.
